findings.claim: Sealed-class secrecy is broken at the metadata layer: oracle_class_map reveals every sealed case slot, family, VALID_CONTROL/INVALID_CONTROL label, seed slot and strata; case_catalog additionally reveals category, component scope, gaming and negative-control flags, while sealed_manifest lists oracle_class_map as a public artifact and declares contains_hidden_oracle=false. A candidate can special-case identifiers or infer required behavior without private values.
findings.recommended_test: DET-PBI-LEAK: construct the exact candidate-visible bundle and fail if it contains or derivably exposes sealed slot/family IDs, oracle classes, seed slots/hashes, strata, gaming/negative flags, oracle-interface names or component-target labels; use opaque per-run IDs and keep only commitments outside the adjudicator boundary.

findings.claim: Public-hidden separation is policy-only, not OS-enforced, and the supplied evidence provides no candidate access ledger or deny-list proof. Because labeled sealed metadata is present in the workspace/public manifest, declarations of prospective isolation do not establish non-access.
findings.recommended_test: DET-PBI-ACCESS: before each run, attempt read/list/stat/open against every sealed, oracle and seed path from the candidate identity; require deterministic denial, record the access ledger, and invalidate the cohort on any access or missing ledger.

findings.claim: The catalog names five oracle interfaces, but sealed_manifest binds only ORACLE-INTERFACE-V1. The allowed evidence does not prove that each named interface and its scoring semantics are independently frozen, enabling oracle-contract drift.
findings.recommended_test: DET-PBI-ORACLE-BIND: collect every catalog oracle_interface value and require exactly one manifest digest plus schema/version digest for each; fail missing, extra, aliasing or changed mappings.

findings.claim: False-positive evidence is underpowered in the sealed map: only four VALID_CONTROL records exist, one per component scope. Transformation names are repeated on families, but no allowed record binds generated valid-control variants, expected relations or variant hashes, so transformed cases cannot be counted as independent false-positive evidence.
findings.recommended_test: DET-PBI-FP: freeze minimum valid-control denominators and independent seeds per component/stratum; require each counted base/variant to have an oracle class, expected relation, seed hash and artifact hash; otherwise return EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT.

findings.claim: The protocol reports 16 public and 20 sealed cases, but the allowed records expose identities only for the 20 sealed slots. No replayable proof shows that public cases, sealed cases, generator inputs and transformed variants are disjoint or non-near-duplicates.
findings.recommended_test: DET-PBI-SEPARATION: before results, compare canonical content, generator ancestry, seed identity, semantic template ID and transformation closure across public and sealed sets; require zero exact/ancestral/semantic overlap and emit a hash-bound report.

findings.claim: Metamorphic coverage is asserted only as the same ten transformation names on every family. The allowed evidence does not establish applicability, invariance versus equivariance, expected outputs, compositions, order effects, invalid transformations or coverage of gaming and false-block boundaries.
findings.recommended_test: DET-PBI-META: require a frozen matrix of family-by-transformation applicability, expected relation, base/variant hashes, composition pairs and reasoned exclusions; fail uncovered component/category cells and verify permutation plus at least one noncommuting composition per applicable scope.

findings.claim: Publishing unkeyed-looking seed identity hashes is safe only if seeds have adequate entropy and commitments are domain-separated; neither property is established by the allowed evidence.

The artifacts declare prospective, synthetic-only, frozen-before-prototype operation, zero prototype runs, no historical answers and no candidate results; these are favorable declarations but do not cure the leakage and separation failures.

proposed_rules: Reject the current sealed cohort and refreeze new opaque cases/seeds because already exposed class/family metadata cannot be made unseen by redaction.
Separate candidate, generator and oracle identities with enforced read boundaries; expose candidates only inert case payloads and opaque run IDs, never family/class/seed/oracle metadata.
Freeze complete public/sealed lineage, oracle-interface hashes, metamorphic relation matrices, access ledgers and false-positive denominators before any prototype result.
Make integrity gates noncompensatory: leakage, overlap, oracle drift, missing access evidence or insufficient valid controls yields REJECT or EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT, never averaging or voting.
abstentions: No private seed or oracle value was accessed, so seed preimage resistance and oracle correctness are not asserted.
Actual public-hidden content overlap and metamorphic semantics cannot be decided from the allowed evidence; deterministic tests are required.
No candidate quality, architecture ranking or prototype outcome is assessed.
